short: A protracted conflict fought between the Athenian empire and the Peloponnesian League led by Sparta, reshaping the Greek world.
full:
Fought from 431 to 404 BCE, the Peloponnesian War engulfed almost the entire Greek world. It pitted the naval supremacy and vast wealth of the Athenian empire against the unmatched land forces of Sparta and its allies. The conflict was characterised by shifting alliances, plague, brutal sieges, and catastrophic military expeditions, most notably the Athenian disaster in Sicily.

The war ended with the total defeat of Athens following the destruction of its fleet at Aegospotami. Sparta stripped Athens of its empire, walls, and fleet, establishing a brief period of Spartan hegemony that left Greece impoverished and vulnerable to future Macedonian expansion.
